Self-Condensation.description: Information about whether the synthesis involves the self-condensation of a single monomer.

Synergistic Condensation.description: Information about the condensation reaction involving multiple different monomers.

Chirality Induction.description: Methods or steps taken to induce chirality during the synthesis process.

Orientation Arrangement.description: Techniques used to control the orientation or arrangement of the crystalline domains.

Twisted-Stacking.description: Information related to a twisted stacking arrangement of the layers in the material.

Stirring/Agitation.description: Details about stirring or agitation during synthesis, including speed (RPM) and type of stirrer.

Post-synthesis Modification Method.description: The method used for any modifications performed after the initial synthesis.

Chiral Cross-Linking Method.description: The specific method used to cross-link the material with chiral agents.
